title: Etale representations assemble on disjoint scheme components
statement: Let $I$ be a type in the universe of schemes, $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $U_i$ be etale $T$-schemes and $Q_i$ etale $U_i$-schemes. Put $B=\coprod_i U_i$ and $V=\coprod_i Q_i$, with their canonical structure maps $B\to T$ and $\pi:V\to B$, and assume these maps are etale. Suppose each restriction $E|_{U_i}$, transported to the small etale site of $U_i$, is isomorphic as a presheaf to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of the chosen $Q_i$. Then $E|_B$, transported to the small etale site of $B$, is isomorphic to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of the explicit etale $B$-scheme $(V,\pi)$. No finiteness condition or surjectivity of $B\to T$ is assumed. Empty $I$ is allowed.

proof.text: For X_i = Q_i.left and Y_i = U_i.left, show that the natural square of Sigma.map(Q_i.hom) at each coprojection is cartesian. The inverse image of the range of Sigma.ι Y i is the range of Sigma.ι X i: writing a point of the coproduct as (j,x), sigmaι_eq_iff forces j = i. Apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback to this equality of open ranges. The universal property of this square gives a natural isomorphism from the restriction of the lifted Yoneda presheaf of V to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of Q_i.

Let R_i be composition along U_i to B and D_i be base change along this coprojection followed by R_i. The counit of mapPullbackAdj is a natural projection D_i to the identity. Its components are the pullback projections. Their ranges are inverse images of the component ranges, so they are disjoint and jointly surjective. Etale.isIso_piLift_of_disjoint makes the restriction from any sheaf H to the product of D_i.op composed with H.obj an isomorphism, objectwise. piObjIso and NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app make this an isomorphism of presheaves.

Let F be E.over B transported to the small etale site of B. Restricting F along R_i agrees with E.over U_i transported to the small etale site of U_i. The identity of the underlying scheme gives the comparison isomorphism, since Sigma.ι composed with Sigma.desc is U_i.hom. Applying E to this isomorphism proves naturality. Compose with the given local representation and the inverse component Yoneda comparison from step 1.

Give the lifted Yoneda presheaf of V its sheaf structure using Mathlib directly: Subcanonical.of_le applied to etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology, then subcanonical_of_full_of_faithful for Etale.forget B, supplies B.smallEtaleTopology.Subcanonical. Whisker the local isomorphisms from step 3 with base change. Compose the restriction-product isomorphism for F, Pi.mapIso of these local isomorphisms, and the inverse restriction-product isomorphism for the Yoneda sheaf. This gives the desired global presheaf isomorphism. All products and cover arguments allow empty indices.
